name: Eureka Math Grade 3 Module 5
title: Fractions as Numbers on the Number Line

topics.title: Partitioning a Whole into Equal Parts
topics.description: Students partition different models of wholes into equal parts and identify unit fractions.

topics.title: Unit Fractions and Their Relation to the Whole
topics.description: Students build non-unit fractions from unit fractions and represent parts of one whole.

topics.title: Comparing Unit Fractions and Specifying the Whole
topics.description: Students compare unit fractions using fraction strips and specify the whole.

topics.title: Fractions on the Number Line
topics.description: Students place and compare fractions on the number line.

topics.title: Equivalent Fractions
topics.description: Students recognize and generate equivalent fractions.

topics.title: Comparison, Order, and Size of Fractions
topics.description: Students compare fractions with the same numerator and order fractions.
